title: experiment-health-sla-instrumentation-roadmap
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Goal: Create a repeatable roadmap that defines experiment health SLAs, the minimal instrumentation required to validate experiments (A/B, canary, feature flag rollouts), and concrete evaluation milestones tied to rollout gates. This ticket captures the PM-owned plan for what to instrument, metric definitions, alert thresholds, and the handoff to Eng/Design for implementation. The outcome should allow product and platform teams to run safe progressive rollouts with clear pass/fail criteria and automated health checks.
milestones: M1 - Instrument event schema and surface key signals (latency, error, cost, quality) - due 2026-03-01 - owner: ENG (ENG-3451)
M2 - Define SLA matrix and per-metric thresholds for canary / AB / staged rollouts - due 2026-03-10 - owner: PM (this ticket)
M3 - Dashboard and alerting templates in Console with dashboards + runbook links - due 2026-03-24 - owner: ENG/Observability
M4 - Small-scale canary run (5% traffic) with automated gating checks - due 2026-04-01 - owner: PM/Eng
M5 - Full rollout playbook + post-rollout quality evaluation and retrospective - due 2026-04-15 - owner: PM/SE
metrics: Latency: p50 / p95 / p99 token-generation latency (measured by runtime telemetry and request traces) - threshold pessimistic to baseline +10%
Error rate: 5xx and runtime exception spikes (alert if > baseline +2x for 10m window)
Quality delta: Eval harness task score delta on representative prompt suite (automated nightly evals) - require non-regression within confidence bounds
Cost per 1k tokens: change in per-token compute cost (billing + runtime telemetry) - flag if delta causes >10% unit cost increase
Hallucination proxy: rerank fallback/QA signal (production user-reported QA and eval-set hallucination metric) - threshold: no regression beyond defined tolerance
rollout_plan: Stage 0 - Local/bench validation: unit tests + perf runs (ENG) - no traffic
Stage 1 - Internal canary: 0.5% internal traffic / synthetic load for 24h - automated smoke checks (console dashboard) must pass
Stage 2 - External canary: 5% real traffic for 48h with continuous gating; if any soft-threshold breaches, pause and investigate
Stage 3 - Gradual ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 60% over 3 deployment windows with automated checks before each step
Stage 4 - Full rollout and 7-day quality observation; schedule postmortem if any gate triggered during ramp
links: Feature flag ticket: ENG-3451 - runtime event schema changes
notes: 2026-02-18 - Sofia: Kickoff meeting held with Eng (Marco), Observability, and Design. Agreed to treat quality delta and latency as primary gating metrics.
2026-02-25 - Marco: ENG sketch for event schema posted; note about adding sampling for high-volume debug traces to avoid cardinality explosion.
2026-03-02 - PM review: tightened rollback criteria to include cost delta >10% in addition to quality regressions.
2026-03-08 - Design feedback: dashboard must include per-model and per-route breakdowns; added DES-4129 for dashboard UX polish.
Open trade-offs: Need to balance sensitivity of alerts (false positives) vs. safety. Proposed solution: two-tier thresholds (soft warning + hard fail) and human-in-the-loop for soft warnings.
